thread:
maya.chen: Heads up — AcmeHealth usage down ~45% week-over-week, renewal in 6w. New interim VP Eng is not in the loop. They started a POC with NimbusAI.

alex.rivera: On it. Do we have recent dashboard + top failing routes?

maya.chen: Sent the 7d overview in #dashboards earlier, but here's quick: active sessions 210 -> 115, avg latency stable, generate tokens down 52%.

redwood-bot: Alert: customer_health_score dropped from 78 to 42 for acmehealth — see https://console.redwood/internal/customers/acmehealth/health

josh.patel: Alex, can you ping the exec sponsor? If decision-maker changed that's biggest risk.

alex.rivera: @maya who is the new contact? and when did the CTO leave?

maya.chen: CTO left 3w ago; interim VP Eng is 'R. Patel' (rpatel@acme). Primary user contact still 'Lina (lina@acme)'. Lina's activity dropped too.

priya.singh: We should schedule a short health check + ROI recap. Offer to run targeted enablement on their most-used flows.

dan.oconnor: I can prepare a perf comparison vs Nimbus — quick matrix of feature parity + cost estimate. Need logs for last 30 days.

maya.chen: Attaching short snippet: ```top routes: /summarize (usage -60%), /chat (usage -48%)
error rate stable <0.5%```

josh.patel: Ask sales to pause auto-renew notices until we complete the check? don't want to trigger RFP.

alex.rivera: Agree. I'll pause renew emails. I'll also request an intro to R. Patel. @priya can you lead the health call? propose tues 10am PT?

priya.singh: I can. I'll own the agenda: 15m ROI recap, 15m enablement, 15m next steps + exec alignment.

dan.oconnor: I'll share a one-pager comparison and a config checklist for enablement.

maya.chen: Also capture feedback on model outputs — Lina mentioned hallucinations in last sprint. Priya, can you capture examples during call and file a bug if needed?

priya.singh: Yep — I'll collect examples and tag eng. Also propose 90-day extension + 10% credit if they commit to a proof-of-value within 30 days. Alex ok with that?

alex.rivera: Ok to offer pending legal review.

josh.patel: Labeling this as 'risk-high' in Gainsight and flag for AE escalation.

maya.chen: Thanks team. Action items: Alex intro to R.Patel by EOD, Priya schedule call (Tues 10am PT), Dan deliver comparison by Mon EOD, Maya prep usage slides. I'll update the health score after the call.

priya.singh: :thumbsup: I'll create a shared doc and capture notes. cc @dan.oconnor for logs access.

alex.rivera: Intro sent. R. Patel replied 'open to chat' — cc'd them here. Good momentum.

redwood-bot: Task created: CS-4829 'AcmeHealth renewal triage' assigned to priya.singh, due 2024-05-14.
